posts.title: Interactive Programming Environments
posts.description: In the Spring of 2025, I taught a University course titled Interactive Programming Environments. posts.description: The Teletype Model 35 is a modification of the Model 28 design (I have previously written about the Teletype Model 28 on my radio pages) extended to support the 7-bit ASCII character encoding.
